title: The Last Echo Again
author: Rosalind Hartwell
blurb: Rafael Reyes, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
